parameters.name: AppId
parameters.description: The ID of the application. You can call the ListApplication operation to obtain the application ID. For more information, see [ListApplication](~~149390~~).

parameters.name: Replicas
parameters.description: The number of application instances to start.

parameters.name: Timeout
parameters.description: The timeout period for the change process, in seconds. Valid values: 1 to 1800. Default value: 600.
